jobDescription:
Project description
We are seeking a Senior Murex Technical Consultant (MxML/Java) to lead enhancements and integrations across front to back Murex streams for a Tier 1 banking client. The role focuses on regulatory reporting uplift, accounting migration controls, and market risk reporting (MRS/Single Report, VaR/Stress), including changes to Pre Trade rules, Datamart/Viewer, Back Office workflows, and EOD/Intraday extracts. The consultant will design and implement MxML exchange workflows, Java-based interfaces with upstream/downstream systems, and contribute to environment/config management and release automation.

  • Perform technical analysis, solution design, and impact assessment for new business requirements / initiatives
  • Design, build, and enhance MxML Exchange workflows for pre trade validation, trade enrichment, and STP.
  • Set up and manage messaging middleware for real time and batch interfaces
  • Contribute to regulatory and risk reporting solutions using MxML / Datamart, EOD and intraday reporting changes
  • Build Datamart/Viewer extracts, EOD/Intraday SQL extracts, and performance tuned queries.
  • Support environment/configuration management, troubleshoot MxML exchanges, and optimize jobs and launchers for stability and performance.
  • Mentor and guide junior team members.

  • Solid understanding of Murex pre trade and post trade workflows, booking sequences, completion checks, and exception handling
  • Experience in integrating Murex with upstream trade booking systems like Markitwire and downstream risk, or regulatory platforms
  • Experience with Configuration Management using MX CTT and version management
  • Exposure to DevOps ( CI/CD), Git based config version control, automated deployment of Environment packs, integration with tools such as Jenkins
  • Pre Trade rules (incl. UDF population) and Accounting (rules, control templates, regeneration)

Job Description
Title: AI Marketing Research Associate
Experience: Fresher/Entry Level

Net Solutions is looking for an unusually sharp university student or recent graduate in the UK to work with our marketing team on research, content, AI-assisted workflows, and marketing operations. This is not a conventional marketing internship. We are looking for someone who can take an unfamiliar business question, research it properly, use AI intelligently, challenge what the AI produces, and turn the work into something useful. You do not need years of marketing experience. You do need to be a strong thinker, researcher, and communicator.


Responsibilities
  • Researching industries, companies, competitors, and market trends
  • Reviewing AI-generated articles and marketing copy for logic, accuracy, and weak arguments
  • Finding and verifying credible primary sources for claims and statistics
  • Researching prospects and target accounts for campaigns and events
  • Comparing competitor positioning, services, and go-to-market approaches
  • Supporting SEO and AI-search research
  • Helping turn research into useful content, campaign, and sales material
  • Testing ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other AI tools against real marketing tasks
  • Developing repeatable AI-assisted processes that make our marketing team faster
  • Bringing a UK-market perspective to messaging, research, and campaigns
  • You will work on live Net Solutions initiatives rather than simulated internship projects.


Nice to have
  • Excellent written English
  • Strong research and analytical ability
  • An instinct for questioning information rather than simply accepting it
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • The ability to understand unfamiliar subjects quickly
  • Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini
  • The ability to distinguish credible evidence from something that merely looks credible
  • Good judgment about what makes writing clear, useful, and believable
  • Curiosity about technology, AI, business, and marketing
  • The ability to work independently once the objective is clear
  • A marketing or technical degree is not required.
  • HOW WE THINK ABOUT AI
  • We expect you to use AI extensively.
  • We also expect you to recognize when it is wrong, generic, poorly reasoned, or unsupported.
  • If your approach is simply to ask ChatGPT to produce an answer and submit it, this role will not be a good fit.
  • The ability to challenge AI output matters more to us than knowing clever prompts.
  • WORKING ARRANGEMENT
  • This is a 12-week, part-time paid position, requiring approximately 1520 hours per week.
  • The role is UK-based and remote, and will involve working with members of the Net Solutions team in India. Some availability during UK mornings will therefore be important.
  • Hours can be arranged around university commitments.
  • COMPENSATION
  • 1620 per hour, depending on demonstrated ability and experience.


Collaboration
  • SELECTION PROCESS
  • 1. Application
  • Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile and, if possible, something that demonstrates how you think, research, or write.
  • 2. Paid practical assignment
  • Shortlisted candidates will receive a short exercise involving research, AI-generated content, fact checking, and judgment.
  • You may use any AI tools you want.
  • We are interested in both what you produce and how you got there.
  • 3. Conversation
  • A short discussion about your assignment, how you approached it, what you disagreed with, and what you would do differently.
  • Exceptional performers may be considered for future opportunities with Net Solutions.

title: AI Adoption & Enablement Manager (Part Time)
jobDescription:
Required Qualification

- 12+ years of professional experience.
- Meaningful experience in Finance Operations, Business Operations, Shared Services, Global Business Services, BPO or a comparable operational environment.
- Strong understanding of administrative and transactional finance processes; experience across areas such as AP, AR, billing, collections, cash application, reconciliations and reporting is highly desirable.
- Strong hands-on experience using Generative AI tools, particularly Microsoft Copilot and ChatGPT, in a business environment.
- Demonstrated ability to identify practical AI use cases and translate technology into improvements in day-to-day work.
- Strong training, facilitation, coaching, presentation and stakeholder-engagement capabilities.
- Experience working with global and geographically distributed teams.
- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
- Ability and willingness to work flexible shifts when required to engage teams across global time zones.
- Ability to work independently and effectively in a remote / work-from-home environment.

Preferred Qualification

Preferred / Advantageous
- Experience leading technology adoption, change management, process improvement or transformation initiatives.
- Experience in a global shared-services, professional-services, insurance, financial-services or business-services organization.
- Knowledge of Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate or Power Platform.
- Understanding of AI agents and workflow automation.
- Lean, Six Sigma, process-improvement or change-management experience/certification.
- Experience developing learning programs, communities of practice or champion networks.
- Understanding of responsible AI, data security and appropriate enterprise use of Generative AI.
Ideal Candidate Profile
- Passionate and genuinely curious about Generative AI and how it can transform work.
- A sophisticated hands-on user of ChatGPT, Copilot and related tools - not someone whose knowledge is primarily theoretical.
- Understands business processes and operational realities, not just technology.
- Can quickly understand someone s work and identify realistic opportunities where AI can help.
- Can turn complex AI capabilities into simple, compelling and practical examples.
- An excellent presenter, facilitator and coach who can engage both frontline employees and senior executives.
- Comfortable influencing people without direct authority.
- Commercially minded and focused on measurable outcomes.
- Self-motivated, adaptable and effective in a remote, global working environment.
- Continuously experiments, learns and stays current as AI capabilities evolve.

Key Responsibilities

1. AI Adoption Practical Enablement
- Lead practical adoption of Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT and other approved Generative AI tools across global teams.
- Deliver engaging, hands-on workshops, demonstrations, learning sessions, office hours and individual coaching.
- Teach employees how to use AI effectively for their actual work rather than relying on generic AI examples.
- Develop role-based prompting techniques, reusable prompts, templates, workflows and practical guidance.
- Help employees progress from basic AI usage to integrating AI into their normal day-to-day work.
- Make Generative AI understandable and accessible to employees with different levels of technical proficiency.

2. Finance, Operations Shared Services Use Cases
Work directly with business teams to identify and implement practical AI opportunities across activities such as:
- Accounts Payable and invoice-related activities
- Accounts Receivable, collections and cash application
- Billing and invoicing
- Reconciliations and data validation
- Financial and operational reporting
- Administrative and shared-services activities
- Email drafting, summarization and communication management
- Meeting preparation, notes and follow-up actions
- Research, information synthesis and document review
- Standard operating procedures, process documentation and knowledge management
- Process analysis, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement
The individual must understand the underlying process and business objective before recommending an AI solution.

3. Use-Case Discovery Scaling
- Partner with teams to discover high-value AI opportunities and prioritize them based on practicality and business impact.
- Convert business problems into practical Copilot, ChatGPT or AI-enabled approaches that employees can use themselves.
- Build and maintain a reusable library of proven AI use cases, prompts, playbooks and examples.
- Develop function-specific AI playbooks for Finance, Operations, Shared Services and other corporate functions.
- Identify successful practices in one team or region and scale them across the global organization.
- Partner with technology or automation teams when a use case requires a more advanced solution, workflow or agent.

4. Global Engagement Facilitation
- Work with employees and leaders across North America, Europe, Asia and other regions.
- Operate flexibly across shifts and time zones to support a global workforce.
- Build credibility with both operational employees and senior business leaders.
- Adapt communication, examples and facilitation style for different cultures, functions and levels of AI maturity.
- Create and support a global network of AI champions or power users who can reinforce adoption locally.
- Communicate AI concepts in simple business language and inspire employees to experiment responsibly.

5. Change Management Continuous Improvement
- Drive behavioral change so that employees move from learning about AI to consistently using it to improve their work.
- Identify barriers to adoption and develop practical interventions to address them.
- Create communications, learning journeys and engagement activities that sustain adoption.
- Capture and communicate success stories that demonstrate tangible business value.
- Bring a continuous-improvement mindset and challenge traditional ways of working where AI can provide a better approach.

6. Measurement Business Impact
Success will be measured by business outcomes, not simply the number of training sessions delivered. The role will establish and track measures such as:
- AI adoption and active usage
- Employee proficiency and confidence
- Number of practical use cases implemented
- Hours of work or capacity saved
- Reduction in repetitive/manual activities
- Productivity, quality or cycle-time improvements
- Use cases successfully replicated across teams or regions
- Employee and stakeholder feedback
- Documented examples of measurable changes in how work is performed

[overview] Role Overview
We are seeking a senior, highly practical and passionate AI Adoption Enablement Manager to accelerate the effective use of Generative AI across our global organization. The role requires a distinctive hybrid skill set: deep practical knowledge of tools such as Microsoft Copilot and ChatGPT, meaningful experience in Finance Operations and/or Business Operations, strong process thinking, and the ability to engage, coach and influence employees across functions, cultures and geographies.
This is not a traditional AI engineering role and it is not simply an AI training role. The successful candidate must understand how work is actually performed and be able to translate AI capabilities into practical, relevant ways of improving day-to-day activities. The goal is measurable change in how people work - not just awareness or training attendance.
What Makes This Role Different
Knowing how to use AI tools is only one part of the requirement. We are looking for someone who can combine AI knowledge with real operational experience. For example, the individual should be able to sit with an Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Billing, Collections, Shared Services or administrative team, understand the work being performed, identify where AI can help, demonstrate a practical solution, coach employees to use it effectively, and measure the resulting improvement.
[/overview]

title: AI Engineering - Development Lead
jobDescription:
Job Summary

We are looking for an AI Engineering - Development Lead to lead the design and development of AI-powered applications, intelligent agents, and enterprise AI solutions. The role combines strong hands-on expertise in Generative AI, Agentic AI, CrewAI, LangChain and Solution Architecture with a working understanding of AI Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC).

The ideal candidate will be able to translate business and security requirements into scalable AI solutions while ensuring that AI systems are designed with appropriate governance, risk, security and compliance considerations.

Key Responsibilities

AI Engineering & Development

  • Lead the architecture, development and deployment of Generative AI and Agentic AI applications.
  • Design and build multi-agent workflows and intelligent AI solutions using CrewAI, LangChain/LangGraph and related frameworks.
  • Develop LLM-powered applications including RAG pipelines, AI agents, tool/function calling, orchestration and workflow automation.
  • Evaluate and integrate LLMs, embedding models, vector databases and AI/ML services based on business requirements.
  • Establish development standards, reusable frameworks and best practices for AI application development.
  • Lead technical design, code reviews, performance optimisation and troubleshooting across AI engineering initiatives.
  • Work closely with engineering, product, cybersecurity and business teams to take AI solutions from concept through production.

Solution Architecture

  • Own the end-to-end solution architecture for enterprise AI and Agentic AI platforms.
  • Translate functional, technical, security and compliance requirements into scalable and maintainable architectures.
  • Design solutions covering LLM orchestration, APIs, microservices, data pipelines, vector databases, cloud infrastructure and AI application layers.
  • Evaluate build-vs-buy decisions and recommend appropriate AI platforms, models, frameworks and technologies.
  • Ensure solutions are designed for scalability, reliability, observability, security and cost optimisation.
  • Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance to development teams.

AI Governance, Risk & Compliance

  • Incorporate AI Governance, Risk and Compliance principles into the design and development lifecycle.
  • Apply working knowledge of ISO/IEC 42001 and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF) to AI solution architecture and development.
  • Support AI risk assessments, AI impact assessments, governance controls and responsible AI practices.
  • Identify and address risks related to LLM security, prompt injection, data leakage, hallucinations, model misuse, bias, explainability, privacy and third-party AI dependencies.
  • Work with GRC, cybersecurity and compliance teams to translate regulatory and governance requirements into practical technical controls.
  • Support development of documentation covering AI system purpose, risks, controls, data flows, model usage and governance requirements.
  • Ensure AI solutions maintain appropriate traceability, monitoring, auditability and human oversight.

Technical Leadership

  • Lead and mentor AI engineers and developers, providing technical direction and best practices.
  • Define development methodologies, coding standards and architecture principles for AI engineering.
  • Stay current with emerging developments across GenAI, Agentic AI, LLMs, AI security, AI governance and AI engineering frameworks.
  • Conduct technical evaluations and proof-of-concepts for new AI technologies and frameworks.
  • Collaborate with senior stakeholders to communicate complex AI architecture and risk considerations in a clear and practical manner.

Required Technical Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience in Generative AI / LLM application development.
  • Strong experience with CrewAI and LangChain/LangGraph.
  • Experience building AI agents, multi-agent systems and agentic workflows.
  • Strong programming experience in Python; experience with APIs, microservices and backend development.
  • Experience with RAG, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering and LLM orchestration.
  • Good understanding of cloud-based AI architecture across platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP.
  • Experience with REST APIs, databases, containers and modern software development practices.
  • Strong understanding of Solution Architecture, system design and enterprise application architecture.
  • Knowledge of AI application security and secure AI engineering practices.

AI GRC & Compliance Knowledge

  • Working knowledge of ISO/IEC 42001 - AI Management System (AIMS).
  • Working knowledge of NIST AI RMF and its core concepts around Govern, Map, Measure and Manage.
  • Understanding of AI risk management, responsible AI, AI governance frameworks and compliance requirements.
  • Ability to translate governance and compliance requirements into technical architecture, engineering controls and operational processes.
  • Knowledge of AI security risks such as prompt injection, data poisoning, model abuse, insecure output handling and sensitive data exposure.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Engineering, AI, Data Science or a related discipline.
  • 8+ years of overall software engineering / technology experience, with significant experience in AI/GenAI engineering.
  • Experience leading AI engineering or architecture teams.
  • Certifications or formal training in AI Governance, ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF, Responsible AI, Cloud or Cybersecurity would be an advantage.
  • Experience working with enterprise cybersecurity, GRC or compliance teams is preferred.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a hands-on AI Engineering leader with strong architecture capabilities who can bridge the gap between AI development and AI governance. They should be comfortable moving between: AI Development Agentic AI Solution Architecture AI Security GRC & Compliance. The candidate should be technically strong enough to design and build AI solutions, while also understanding how those solutions need to be governed, assessed and controlled in an enterprise environment.

About the Role
We are looking for a Senior Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE) to join our Cloud deployment team and take ownership of the reliability, scalability, automation, and operational excellence of our core database infrastructure.
You will work across PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and Kafka , supporting a multi-cloud, Kubernetes-based platform at significant scale. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex infrastructure and database challenges, eliminating operational toil, and building highly automated systems.
You will partner closely with Software Engineering, SRE, Platform Engineering, and Product teams to ensure our data platforms are highly available, scalable, secure, and resilient.
What You ll Own Managed PostgreSQL Fleet Orchestration
  • Standardize and automate the lifecycle management of a fleet of 1000+ PostgreSQL instances across Azure, AWS, and GCP.
  • Build and maintain infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation frameworks.
  • Automate provisioning, configuration, patching, upgrades, backups, and operational workflows.
  • Improve consistency and reliability across our PostgreSQL fleet while reducing manual operational effort.
  • Work with cloud-managed PostgreSQL services including Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Flexible Server, Amazon RDS, and GCP Cloud SQL .
  • Evolve our provisioning and configuration approach using Kubernetes-based and Terraform-driven workflows.
Hybrid Elasticsearch Operations
  • Design, operate, and scale high-performance Elasticsearch clusters across Elastic Cloud (SaaS) and ECK (self-managed Kubernetes) environments.
  • Own the reliability and performance of Elasticsearch infrastructure supporting search, semantic retrieval, vector workloads, and high-volume operational data.
  • Establish best practices around cluster sizing, capacity planning, shard management, upgrades, backups, monitoring, and disaster recovery.
  • Support Elasticsearch deployments where PostgreSQL is the source of truth as well as environments where Elasticsearch is the authoritative datastore .
  • Build automation to simplify provisioning and lifecycle management across Elastic Cloud and ECK.

Kafka Streaming Infrastructure

  • Drive capacity planning, partition and topic design, replication strategy, and broker-level performance tuning.
  • Establish and automate best practices around upgrades, rolling restarts, backups/disaster recovery, and schema evolution (e.g. Schema Registry).
  • Build monitoring and alerting for consumer lag, broker health, ISR status, and throughput to enable early incident detection.
  • Partner with Software Engineering to ensure producer/consumer patterns, retention policies, and topic ownership scale cleanly as usage grows.
What You Bring
  • 6+ years of experience in Database Reliability Engineering, Database Engineering, SRE, Platform Engineering, or a closely related role.
  • Strong hands-on experience operating PostgreSQL at scale , preferably in cloud-managed environments.
  • Strong experience with Elasticsearch , including cluster administration, performance tuning, scaling, shard management, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience operating databases and stateful workloads on Kubernetes .
  • Experience with Kafka or another distributed database/storage system is highly valuable.
  • Strong Infrastructure as Code experience with Terraform or similar tools.
  • Experience with at least one major cloud platform - Azure, AWS, or GCP - with exposure to multi-cloud environments preferred.

Good to Have

Proficiency in Go for building automation, tooling, or operators; Python or another scripting language is a plus.

  • Experience operating databases across multi-cloud and private-cloud environments .

What Success Looks Like
  • Database provisioning and lifecycle operations become highly automated and repeatable.

products

title: Senior Staff Engineer
jobDescription:
Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers.

Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.

Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we ve raised $31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprintos extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.

Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.

Life as a Sprinter -

Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we dont wait for permission; we step in.

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams arent built by sitting together; theyre built by pulling in the same direction.

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.

The mission -

Autonomy is the easy half. Making it defensible is the hard half.

What the platform produces is not a suggestion that a customer can take or leave. Its used as fact by auditors and enterprise buyers whose decisions depend on us being right. Wrong in one direction, a customer loses a certification because of us. Wrong in the other, we bury them in noise until they stop reading anything we send.

Your mission is to make a defensible half, making agent judgment something a third party will accept.

Where youll leave your mark

Agents whose output nobody re-checks. Youll see how we prove an agent is trustworthy: evaluation harnesses that gate releases rather than run quarterly, golden sets built with real compliance experts, regression suites assembled from production traces, and drift detection that fires before a customer notices. Not a set of scripts - a platform every other team builds on. Youll know it works when a compliance lead stops reviewing a category of output, and nothing breaks.

A system that can prove what it said, and admit when it didnt know. Compliance is a claim about the past, which means state as of a date has to be held separately from when we learned it, and every artefact has to carry unbroken provenance from the source system to the audit package. The other half of the problem is honesty under failure. At several hundred connectors, partial failures are normal, and a connector returning nothing because Okta is down must never look like a control genuinely failing. Passing, failing and unknown are three different states, and that distinction has to survive all the way to the interface.

Beyond those two, there are surfaces youll work across without owning alone: tenant isolation and enterprise identity as we move upmarket, the inference economics that decide whether continuous monitoring is viable at scale, and how we model 200 frameworks so the next one is cheap. And since every engineer here will be building with agents within a year, well expect the practice to be better across the org because you joined.

The kind of builder were looking for -

  • Someone who has built something that changed the shape of the work. Not a prototype - a system where an LLM took autonomous, multi-step action against real data and real users, and displaced something people used to do by hand. Well want to hear what it replaced, what it cost, what its failure rate was, and how you measured it.

  • An engineer who treats the model as an untrusted subsystem. Constrained outputs, independent verification, thresholds that escalate rather than guess, a clear line between what the model decides and what it only proposes. Were more interested in how your system detected and contained a bad output than in how it tried to prevent one.

  • Depth in at least two of these, with room to pick up the rest here: production LLM and agent systems; temporal and provenance data modeling; high-fan-out integration reliability; multi-tenant and enterprise identity; inference cost engineering; domain modeling for messy regulatory rules.

  • 10+ years building software, at least two of them at Staff scope - setting technical direction that engineers outside your reporting line followed.

  • Range. Some quarters this role is an architect setting direction, some quarters its the person taking on the problem nobody has cracked, some quarters its carrying a team through a hard delivery. The people who do well here read what the company needs and adapt.

  • Willingness to challenge how we build, and to hold the line when it counts. Were hiring partly for disagreement - on our architecture, our agent design, our standards. That includes telling go-to-market what we cant yet defend, and offering a path rather than a refusal.

  • Influence without authority. Nobody on this team reports to you. Your leverage is clarity, credibility and the quality of your reasoning across Engineering, Product, Security and CX - and since were remote-first, most of that happens in writing.

How we care for our Sprinters
  • Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach.
  • Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance.
  • We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills.
  • We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to.
  • Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary.
  • Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you.

Inclusion & Diversity -

At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed-not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.

Were proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. Job Summary

As a Senior Technical Consultant (Shift Lead) in the Shared Data/ODSP Factory, you will lead on-shift technical delivery for tenant-to-tenant migrations of collaboration content across Microsoft 365, typically SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business and associated Teams/M365 Group content structures. You will run a controlled, metrics-driven migration factory, ensuring runbooks are executed consistently, migrations are scheduled and monitored, permissions/metadata fidelity is validated and defects are remediated efficiently. You will be accountable for shift throughput, quality gates, evidence capture and operational reporting while coordinating escalations and ensuring seamless handovers across the 24x7 model.

Responsibilities

  • Lead technical execution of SharePoint/OneDrive/ODSP migration waves during your shift, ensuring runbook adherence and predictable throughput.
  • Own shift triage for failures (throttling, permissions mapping issues, blocked files, metadata/versioning exceptions, large list/library constraints, URL/path constraints).
  • Validate readiness: source/target access, migration accounts/consents, pre-checks, quota constraints and cutover schedule alignment.
  • Configure, schedule and monitor migration jobs using the approved toolset (native and/or third-party), proactively identifying risks before they become wave blockers.
  • Enforce quality gates: sampling/validation outcomes, permission parity checks, metadata fidelity and user experience verification.
  • Maintain operational control of the shift backlog and prioritise tasks based on cutover plans, dependencies and SLA.
  • Produce and manage evidence packs per wave: migration reports, exception logs, remediation records, sign-off artefacts and audit trail completeness.
  • Coordinate handovers with clear exceptions, blockers and next actions; ensure continuity of long-running migration jobs across shifts.
  • Drive continuous improvement: update runbooks, known error catalogues and operational dashboards; reduce recurring failures and rework.
  • Manage escalations (vendor support, platform support pathways, programme technical leadership) with complete diagnostic context and clear asks.

Requirements

  • Delivered at least one production tenant-to-tenant migration of SharePoint Online and/or OneDrive (ODSP) content as a senior SME/lead.
  • Deep expertise in SharePoint Online/OneDrive architecture concepts relevant to migration: site structures, permissions models, sharing/links, metadata/versioning, information architecture constraints.
  • Hands-on experience with migration tooling in this space (e.g., ShareGate and/or Quest ODM or equivalent) and the ability to run migrations at scale.
  • Proven ability to run migration operations in a factory model: scheduling, monitoring, exception handling and quality gates at high volume.
  • Strong understanding of security/compliance impacts in migrated content (sensitivity labels/retention behaviours where applicable; access governance, least privilege).
  • Strong runbook discipline and evidence capture practice; comfortable being held to audit standards for every wave.

Good-to-Have

  • Experience migrating Teams-associated content dependencies (files in SharePoint, OneDrive artefacts linked to user data used by collaboration features) and coordinating sequencing.
  • Familiarity with multi-geo considerations and URL/domain nuances that can impact migration execution.
  • Microsoft certifications relevant to Microsoft 365 administration (e.g., MS-102) or SharePoint specialization, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience using PowerShell/Graph for reporting, bulk checks, or automation around migration readiness and validation.
  • Knowledge of data governance, information architecture and content lifecycle management in Microsoft 365.

Interpersonal & Consulting Skills

  • Keeps shift teams focused on plan and standards; prevents uncontrolled variation in execution.
  • Communicates clearly with upstream/downstream disciplines (Identity, Teams, Adoption, Security) to manage dependencies and unblock progress.

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Orgzit is a SaaS software product business. We help small and mid-sized businesses implement systems in their sales, operations, and accounting functions with CRM & workflow automation software solutions.


Our unique value proposition is our no-code technology advantage, which enables us to offer customised business software solutions that are the easiest to use and implement in the shortest time.

Orgzit was founded in 2016 by Pavan Verma and Nitin Verma to solve the problems of SMBs they experienced firsthand in their family and friends' businesses. Over the past 9+ years, we have served more than 100 businesses. Our customers rely on our product daily to automate their sales and operational processes and grow their businesses.

We are a member of two accelerators: Upekkha, the #1 accelerator for SaaS businesses in India, and Nasscom Startups. We are a profitable business and are investing in growing 100% every year for the next five years.


Our customer, Carolyn Arote of CAVH from Florida, USA, says, My team is able to track all sales-related things on Orgzit. It has been worth its weight in Gold.


Our team member Karan Asthana says, “Orgzit has a very open, transparent, and friendly culture. You get to work closely with visionary founders and build a world-class business. It is the best place for someone who wants to learn and become a master of their domain.”

Watch this video to discover why you should join us and be part of building a new generation of business software.


Visit our website at https://orgzit.com to learn more about us.


Who Are We Looking For


We're looking for a highly organised, trustworthy Executive Assistant who can manage accounts, HR, recruitment, and founder support with equal ease. The ideal Executive Assistant is proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable juggling multiple workstreams without dropping the ball. Above all, they should be someone who takes ownership, learns fast, and wants to grow with a young, fast-moving startup.

  • Accounts & Finance: Own end-to-end accounting operations: invoicing, expense tracking, monthly GST/TDS filings and payments, P&L dashboard reporting.

  • Recruitment: Run recruitment drives start to finish: draft JDs, post on job portals, schedule webinars and interviews.
  • Founder & Admin Support: Manage the founder's calendar, inbox, and notes. Set up meetings with customers and manage team access to software tools and applications.

  • Communication: Clear, precise, and confident in both written and verbal communication.
  • Organisation & Attention to Detail: Manages multiple workstreams (accounts, HR, recruitment, admin) without missing tasks.
  • Proactive Ownership: Anticipates needs before being asked and takes initiative to close gaps.
  • Reliability: Dependable and consistent.
  • Discretion & Integrity: Trusted with confidential information, including founder communications, compensation data, and team matters, and handles it with judgment and professionalism..
  • Coordination & Follow-through: Keeps multiple people (team members, candidates, vendors, freelancers) moving toward deadlines without needing constant reminders.
  • Tool Fluency: Comfortable working across Google Sheets, Google Docs, Slack, etc. to move fast and reduce manual effort.
  • AI Tool Proficiency: Skilled at using AI tools like ChatGPT or Claude for research, drafting documents, and writing messages.
  • Ability to learn quickly and apply feedback in real time.

Work Days and Timings

  • Timings: 10am to 7pm

Experience

  • 1+ years of experience.

Benefits


  • Medical insurance
  • Leave encashment
  • Relocation assistance

Why Join Us


As a small, bootstrapped, fast-growing startup, we strive to provide a supportive and rewarding work environment that values our team members’ contributions. We provide an unparalleled environment to professionals looking to grow in their careers:

  • Growth Opportunities: Take on new responsibilities, learn, and grow personally and professionally
  • Ownership and Impact: Make a significant impact on our company's direction and growth
  • Collaborative Environment: Foster teamwork, open communication, and mutual respect
  • Rapid Learning: Wear multiple hats, develop diverse skills, and gain valuable experience

jobDescription:

Dolby is looking for a talented Senior Foundational Audio AI Researcher to join Dolby s research efforts to drive innovation for audio, signal processing, perception, and application of AI in the audio domain. You will drive key innovations for Dolby s core business which allow Dolby and its customers to build products that push the boundaries of sound and multimedia experiences.
You will focus on the creation and implementation of audio and multimedia signal processing technologies from the underlying theoretical concepts to the development of prototypes and demonstrators, with the goal to create new experiences, and explore new horizons in the fields of audio and multimedia signal processing and AI based generation/processing/ synthesis.
What you will do:
You will push the boundaries of the state-of-the-art in audio, video, and multi-modal technologies. The ideal candidate would have a strong background in deep learning, both in terms of conceptual understanding, as well as practical experience. A core aspect of this role involves being able to keep up to date with the literature, implement, and innovate with the bleeding edge in generative models, self-supervised learning, and multi-modal learning. With the explosion of audio, video, and multi-modal foundational models, you will partner closely with Dolby s worldwide AI research staff, which actively pursues the integration of such models into audio and media experiences. You will be able to hit the ground running, innovate, and contribute to such projects. Consequently, experience with language models, question answering, vision-language models, captioning, etc. would be highly beneficial.

Consequently, knowledge or experience in any/all of the following are helpful:
  • Diffusion, autoregressive, or other generative models.
  • Self-supervised, contrastive learning, auto-encoders.

  • Knowledge in audio, video, or text processing is desirable.

About TYLsemi, Inc.

The Opportunity

The AI infrastructure market is exploding. Every hyperscaler, every cloud provider, every AI company is building custom silicon. But they all face the same problem: how do you connect hundreds of chips, deliver clean power at scale, and move terabits of data without melting the package

Thats what we solve. TYLsemi builds the chiplet infrastructure IP - the IO, power delivery, and interconnect building blocks - that makes AI/HPC systems actually work at scale.

This isnt a nice-to-have. Its the critical path.

Why Now The Market Window

The semiconductor industry is going through its biggest architectural shift in 40 years:

  • Moores Law is dead. 2nm and beyond delivers marginal performance gains. The future is chiplets, not monolithic dies.
  • Custom silicon is now mainstream. Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Meta, OpenAI - theyre all designing their own ASICs. The $50B custom silicon market is growing 30% annually.
  • IO and power are the bottleneck. Solve hard problems and provide something which is a category in itself.

The Ask

If youre reading this, youre probably comfortable. You have a good job at a stable company with all the benefits.

This is the bet. Join us and build something that matters.

Or stay comfortable. No judgment.

But if youre the kind of person who wants to take the shot, wed love to talk.

title: Lead - Computer Vision & AI Architect
jobDescription:
We are looking for a Lead Computer Vision & AI Architect to own the technical direction of our core perception stack while staying deeply hands-on. You will lead the design of our real-time movement-perception system multi-camera geometry, 3D pose and mesh estimation, personalized body modeling, live form evaluation, Vision-Language coaching models, and edge deployment and you will also carry end-to-end responsibility for how these pieces fit together as one coherent system across capture, edge runtime, mobile app, and cloud.


This is a hybrid technical-lead and product-ownership role, not a pure people-management position. You will set the perception roadmap, own module-level requirements and acceptance criteria, plan and run execution, and act as the primary technical bridge across engineering, design, hardware, and partner integrations. You will mentor a small, senior team through design and code review — formal people management is not the core of the role today, but technical leadership and delivery ownership are.


Key Responsibilities


1. Technical Leadership & Execution Ownership

  • Technical Direction: Set and own architecture decisions across 3D pose, multi-camera geometry, body/mesh modeling, form evaluation, and edge deployment — and be accountable for their trade-offs.
  • Product Ownership: Translate product goals into clear module-level requirements, scope, priorities, and acceptance criteria for the perception program; decide what ships and what defers.
  • Execution Management: Plan and run sprints, sequence cross-module work, and manage delivery against milestones and measurable KPIs (latency, frame rate, calibration repeatability, demo reliability).
  • Engineering Practice: Foster clean coding, thoughtful design and code reviews, automated testing, clear documentation, and reproducible experiment tracking. Mentor CV and AI/ML engineers technically.

2. System Architecture & Cross-Functional Coordination

  • System Coherence: Own end-to-end architecture coherence across capture, perception, edge runtime, mobile app, and cloud — not just the CV core, but how the whole movement-intelligence loop connects.
  • Interfaces & Dependencies: Define and manage cross-module interface contracts and dependencies so parallel workstreams integrate cleanly.
  • Cross-Functional Bridge: Coordinate day-to-day across full-stack engineering, UI/UX, CV and ML/CV engineers, and — as the team grows — edge/embedded and hardware/firmware engineers, plus partner integrations.
  • Performance Budgets: Establish and enforce real-time latency, frame-rate, memory, and thermal budgets across edge hardware, smart glasses, Linux workstations, and NPUs — from current real-time demo targets (sub-second feedback at 10–15 FPS on Jetson-class simulation) toward productization targets (sub-200ms feedback at 30–60 FPS).

3. Hands-On Computer Vision & 3D Geometry

  • Multi-View Geometry & 3D Pose: Lead hands-on development of camera calibration, multi-camera synchronization, epipolar geometry, 3D joint triangulation, and temporal smoothing across a multi-camera capture rig.
  • Personalized Body Modeling & Form Evaluation: Build pose-to-mesh alignment against a user-specific skeletal/mesh model and a live form-comparison engine that turns movement variance into timely, trustworthy corrective cues.

4. Multimodal AI & Edge Deployment

  • Multimodal AI: Guide evaluation and fine-tuning (LoRA/QLoRA) of Vision-Language Models (e.g. LLaVA, Qwen-VL) for movement interpretation and coaching dialogue.
  • Edge Optimization: Oversee quantization (INT8/FP16) and export to ONNX, TensorRT, TFLite, or CoreML, and real-time inference on Jetson-class edge and NPU targets.

5. R&D and Intellectual Property

  • Patent-Protected Innovation: Help build and document patentable core technology in mirror-aware tracking, personalized 3D motion reconstruction, and real-time form evaluation.

What We Are Looking For

Experience & Leadership

  • Background: 7–10 years in computer vision, AI, or ML engineering, with a track record of owning technical direction and architecture on complex, real-time systems.
  • Hands-On + Coordination: Demonstrated ability to stay deeply hands-on in code while also leading architectural reviews, driving execution, and coordinating delivery across cross-functional teams.
  • Delivery: Proven record of shipping complex engineering projects against deadlines, with rigorous benchmarking and clear technical decision-making.

Computer Vision & 3D Geometry

  • Core Math: Strong grasp of 3D geometry (rigid-body transforms, quaternions, rotation matrices) and projective geometry (calibration, bundle adjustment, triangulation).
  • Pose Systems: Practical experience with 2D/3D pose models (e.g. ViTPose, HRNet, RTMPose, MediaPipe) and multi-camera setups.
  • Toolkit: High proficiency in Python (NumPy, SciPy), OpenCV, and performance-oriented C++.

AI/ML & Multimodal AI

  • Frameworks: Strong experience with PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Multimodal Models: Hands-on work evaluating and fine-tuning Vision-Language Models (VLMs).
  • Agentic AI: Familiarity with agent systems, tool calling, or Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is a plus.

Edge & Deployment

  • Hardware Targets: Experience delivering real-time models to mobile SoCs, NPUs, smart glasses, or embedded hardware.
  • Optimization Tools: Hands-on experience with TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, TFLite, or CoreML.

Nice to Have

  • Education: Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer Vision, Machine Learning, or a related field.
  • Publications or Patents: Work published at CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, or NeurIPS, or granted patents.
  • Domain Experience: Familiarity with biomechanics, fitness technology, sports analytics, or AR/VR.

Summary:

We are looking for a Senior AI/ML Engineer to join an Agent Development Squad building AI-powered financial close automation. You will own the LLM and agent layer, designing and building agent workflows using LangChain/LangGraph, integrating with Azure OpenAI or other frontier LLMs, and ensuring every agent action is traceable, evaluable, and production-grade. This is a hands-on engineering role, not a research role. The platform is Python-first, and you will work alongside backend and frontend engineers in a cross-functional squad.


What You'll Do

  • Design and build LLM-based agent workflows using LangChain and LangGraph, covering multi-step graphs, tool use, agent handoffs, and state management.
  • Integrate and optimize Azure OpenAI or other frontier LLM providers (Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, etc.), managing prompt design, token usage, latency, and model versioning.
  • Build and maintain RAG pipelines covering document ingestion, embedding generation, vector search using pgvector or equivalent vector database, and retrieval-augmented generation for financial document reasoning.
  • Own LLM observability using Langfuse, instrument agent traces, build evaluation harnesses, track confidence scores, and detect model regressions.
  • Collaborate with the Software Engineering Architect on agent orchestration patterns and inter-agent communication contracts.
  • Contribute to confidence threshold calibration, defining the auto-resolve vs. human-escalation boundary per agent.
  • Ensure all agent actions produce structured, auditable outputs compatible with the platform's SOX-compliant governance framework.

Who You Are

AI / LLM Engineering - Primary Gate

  • 6+ years of total software engineering experience with 3+ years building and shipping production-grade LLM-based applications.
  • Proven experience building production-grade agents, both assistive (human-in-the-loop, approval-driven) and ambient (autonomous, background execution), using LangChain, LangGraph, and LangServe; knows when to use each and how they compose.
  • Familiarity with agent communication protocols, specifically Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) and working knowledge of other Agent Development Kits such as Google ADK, AutoGen, CrewAI, or Semantic Kernel.
  • Experience integrating with Azure OpenAI or other frontier LLM provider APIs (Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Mistral, etc.), including structured outputs, function calling, token management, and latency optimization.
  • RAG pipeline development with hands-on experience in at least one vector database (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, FAISS, or equivalent), covering embedding pipelines and retrieval strategies.
  • Prompt lifecycle management and eval pipelines, covering versioning, rollback, environment-specific configuration, and running evaluation harnesses to regression-test prompt changes and validate RAG output.
  • Experience building reliable production agent systems with input/output guardrails, confidence thresholding, fallback handling, and full traceability of every decision and tool call via Langfuse or equivalent.

Backend Engineering

  • Python is your primary language; proficient with FastAPI or equivalent async frameworks for building agent service APIs.
  • PostgreSQL with pgvector or equivalent vector database (Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, FAISS), including schema design for agent state, audit logs, and vector search.
  • Docker and Kubernetes for containerized service deployment in production environments.
  • Azure DevOps CI/CD for integrating AI pipelines into automated build and deployment workflows.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with financial domain data such as accounting entries, reconciliations, accruals, or variance analysis.
  • Familiarity with SOX/GDPR compliance requirements for AI decision audit trails.
  • Contributions to open-source LLM or agent framework projects.
  • Experience with federated learning or model fine-tuning pipelines.

What You'll Learn & Gain

  • End-to-end ownership of the LLM and agent layer on a live enterprise financial platform used by global customers.
  • Deep hands-on experience with LangChain/LangGraph, Azure OpenAI and other frontier LLMs, agent protocols (MCP, A2A), and Langfuse in a production context where quality, auditability, and latency all matter.
  • Exposure to building AI in a high-compliance, SOX-governed environment, balancing model performance with explainability and audit requirements.
  • Collaboration with backend, frontend, and platform engineers in a squad model where your technical decisions directly shape product behavior.

jobDescription:
This role supports both the
Accenture Foundation and the
Global Corporate Citizenship Budget team, contributing to the effective execution, financial stewardship, and governance of Accentures corporate citizenship and philanthropic activities. Corporate Citizenship at Accenture focuses on driving positive social impact through strategic investments, partnerships, and programs that advance inclusion, skills development, and economic empowerment in communities around the world.

The Accenture Foundation, Inc. is a U.S.-based, nonprofit organization that advances these objectives by providing grant funding and supporting initiatives that expand access to economic opportunity, with a strong focus on employment, entrepreneurship, and resilience.

Based in India, the role operates in a highly matrixed, global environment and works closely with leaders and partners across regions and time zones.

The position is split
approximately 50% supporting Accenture Foundation operations and
50% supporting global Corporate Citizenship budget management and reporting. The role requires strong financial discipline, operational rigor, and the ability to work independently within established governance frameworks.


Key Responsibilities

Accenture Foundation Support (Approximately 50%)

  • Support the daytoday operations of the Accenture Foundation, including governance, financial administration, and compliance activities
  • Support Board and Committee governance, including preparation, coordination, and review of meeting materials, financial schedules, and tracking of actions and followups
  • Support the grant lifecycle, including documentation, approvals, disbursements, tracking, and reporting, in line with Foundation policies and cash management requirements
  • Prepare and maintain Foundation financial workpapers, supporting quarterly and annual reporting, audits, and governance reviews, and ensuring adherence to established controls and documentation standards
  • Perform bank account reconciliations, investigating and resolving reconciling items in coordination with Finance and external partners, and ensuring timely and accurate cash reporting
  • Coordinate with Finance, Legal, Tax, Audit, and external auditors to support audits, regulatory requirements, and ongoing compliance activities
  • Maintain accurate, organized financial records, trackers, and documentation, supporting transparency, traceability, and effective Foundation governance


Global Corporate Citizenship Budget Team Support (Approximately 50%)

  • Support global Corporate Citizenship budget management processes, including actuals tracking, forecasting, and variance analysis within cash, pro bono, and DNP budgets
  • Coordinate budget inputs from multiple regions and workstreams, including pro bono and market unit support, to ensure accuracy and timeliness
  • Prepare financial summaries, dashboards, and materials for Global Corporate Citizenship leadership and governance forums
  • Support quarterly and ad hoc financial reviews and budget governance processes; provide additional ad hoc operational support as needs arise
  • Ensure alignment with internal financial policies, controls, and approval requirements
  • Identify opportunities to improve budgeting, reporting, and financial governance processes, and support implementation of enhancements
  • Provide flexible support across additional operational and administrative priorities as the role continues to evolve
  • Support global grant tracking in Accenture''s myGrants tool


Key Outcomes

  • Accurate and timely Foundation and Corporate Citizenship financial reporting

  • Strong financial controls, documentation, and audit readiness
  • Reliable execution across recurring budget and governance cycles
  • Effective coordination across global stakeholders with minimal escalation

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities with limited supervision
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and execution skills
  • Experience in preparing materials for senior leadership or governance forums

  • Ability to work effectively in a global, matrixed environment across time zones
  • Willingness to work second shift India hours


Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with grant management, charitable finance, or governance structures
  • Experience working with global or enterpriselevel budgets
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or similar financial analysis tools


Tools Systems

  • Proficiency in using AI tools (e.g., Copilot, M365, Claude, Amethyst, etc.)
  • Collaboration and documentation tools (e.g., Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive)
  • Experience with enterprise finance or reporting systems is a plus


Additional Information
